h2: Jaguar F-Pace Ingenium Diesel|Timing Chain Issues?|
description: The Ingenium diesel engines fitted across the F-Pace range share the same timing chain and injector seal pattern found across the wider JLR Ingenium family — including Land Rover applications of the same engines. We replace worn timing chains and injector seals as standard.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: Ingenium AJ200D injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are widely documented across Jaguar specialist forums and official TSBs.

heroHook.title: Include In Hero Hook:
heroHook.body: Yes — both verified: Ingenium AJ200D widely documented with multiple TSBs; M156 pre-2012 established Jaguar specialist pattern.

features.title: New Timing Chains
features.body: Replaced as standard (where worn or damaged)

features.title: Peace Of Mind
features.body: No hidden extras — just a stronger, longer-lasting engine
